why: Figure 2 is figure 1 flipped (circles move from the right side of the line to the left side). Figure 3 lies flat with circles above the line, so the next figure flips it: the circles go below the line. Option 2 shows 4 circles hanging under the line. Option 1 is the same as figure 3, not flipped.
trick: When figures come in pairs, look for a flip (mirror) inside each pair.
